prompt: How many years apart was the founding of Snell & Wilmer from the birth of the man who got 3rd place at the 1954 Masters golf tournament?
answer:
Billy Joe Patton, who finished third at the 1954 Masters, was born in **1922**. Snell & Wilmer was founded in **1938**.

**1938 − 1922 = 16 years**, so the founding was **16 years after his birth**.
